{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P and modifies socket connection handling in src/netbase.cpp and socket polling behavior used across network connections.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents socket event loops from busy-spinning continuously when TCP urgent data is received on established connections. Under select(), monitoring the exception set causes repeated wakeups that standard recv calls cannot clear, while this PR restricts exception monitoring specifically to non-blocking connection attempts on Windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/test/ are unit tests for the socket fix and mechanical updates to test utilities to support the new socket flag, not testing framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not alter general test machinery; the test additions only pin the behavior of the socket utility fix."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies the socket abstraction utility in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp by introducing ConnErrorEventFlag.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a flaw in the Sock polling primitive where established sockets were improperly exposed to spurious readiness wakeups from TCP urgent data. It cleanly isolates connection-error exception monitoring to non-blocking connects without altering poll() behavior."
    }
  ],
